honesty: Design authority only. Prefab paths are stubs until Aura binds a mesh. No fabricated gameplay stats are live.

entries.lore_blurb: Hub civic kit. Pre-industrial court, Flower Law plaza, lanterns, limestone. Pinewood Crossing is a sub-dress of this kit outside the walls, not a second city named Vinewood.
entries.art_style_notes: Stylized realism PBR: GTA micro-wear (scratches, peel, stain, edge dirt) on a Palworld-readable silhouette (bold mass, saturated key light, one emissive accent). Visible bevels. Albedo has no baked lighting and is slightly more saturated than a photo. No cel-shade, no generic asset-pack costume, no thin-limb hitboxes. Functional mashup. Foundation is this world's identity. Bevels on every jamb. Unified flooring inside a blend zone.
entries.silhouette_notes: Must read as a pure-black silhouette at 100m and at chase-camera distance. Windup / strike / recover poses stay distinct. Skyline read at 100m from the tall piece in this kit. Ground floor stays the culture; upper floors may be faction retrofit.
